verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents built-in security scanning via Snyk integration (dependency/SAST) and mentions connecting to 'other providers,' but there's no explicit evidence of native secret scanning or dynamic (DAST) scanning consolidated in one platform — these rely on third-party add-ons rather than a unified built-in suite. Missing for 10: dedicated secret-scanning feature, DAST scanning feature, and evidence of a single consolidated dashboard combining all four scan types.
